# docker_stacks (Data Source)

Lists the Swarm stacks, like `docker stack ls`: services grouped by the `com.docker.stack.namespace` label, with the number of services in each (`services_count`). Needs a Swarm manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_stacks" "all" {}

output "stacks" {
  value = { for s in data.docker_stacks.all.stacks : s.name => s.services_count }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of stacks_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply.
- `names` (List of String) The stack names, sorted.
- `stacks` (Attributes List) One entry per stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks))
- `stacks_json` (String) The stack list as one JSON array (the `stack ls --format json` rows).

<a id="nestedatt--stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Upstream `Name`.
- `namespace` (String) Upstream `Namespace`.
- `orchestrator` (String) Upstream `Orchestrator`.
- `services_count` (Number) Upstream `Services`.
